column2: Bonjour et bienvenue dans l'entreprise Wold Company. Nous allons vous transférer vers le standard. Attendez, et tout se passera bien.
Good morning ! Greetings from the world company. Please wait, your call will be forwarded to the person in charge of the phone calls.

I'm sorry, I'm deeply sorry, but the person you're trying to reach is not available. He's actually quite rarely available. In other words, he tends to scandalously run away his own life by using all kinds of derivatives : Copulating with random people, using all sort of drugs and trying to make sense out of pure nonsense. I'm gonna let him know anyway that you called, but don't expect him to call you back.
Guten Tag. Ich bin leider nicht erreichbar. Sie können mich auf meinem Mobiltelefon anrufen. Vielen Dank und auf Wiedersehen.
